business.headline: NSE IPO: Rs 30,000 crore issue likely to open on September 18, say sourcesAccording to sources, the price band for the NSE IPO is likely to be announced on September 15. This will be followed by the anchor book opening on September 17.

PM Modi urges fintech sector to move beyond UPI, embrace next-gen innovationPM Modi said 2026 has opened new possibilities for the financial sector, with technologies such as agentic AI, tokenisation and quantum technology creating new opportunities.

Tata Trusts gets more time in Mehli Mistry case; next hearing October 15The dispute relates to change reports filed with the Charity Commissioner to record Mistry's cessation as a trustee of SRTT, Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and Bai Hirabai Jamsetji Tata Navsari Charitable Institution.

Sensex, Nifty end lower as private banks, crude oil drag marketsThe BSE Sensex ended 555.23 points, or 0.73%, lower at 75,577.58. The Nifty 50 declined 144.05 points, or 0.61%, to end at 23,635.10.

The findings add pressure on FSSAI ahead of the Supreme Court hearing, with respondents also seeking larger labels, total nutrient counts and faster rollout.

Sun Pharma's US pact may reset the playbook for Indian pharmaSun Pharma has struck a deal with the US government to lower medicine prices and expand manufacturing in America. The agreement signals a possible shift for Indian drugmakers towards strategic bargaining and localised production in the US.

Home, savings, investments: India's wallet moves from spending to wealthFrom the next holiday to the next home, Indians appear to be rethinking where their money should go. Are savings, investments and wealth-building becoming the new priorities?

FD vs SIP: Need your money soon? Here's what you should chooseThe FD-versus-SIP debate has no shortage of opinions, especially when investors are looking for the right home for their savings. But what should you consider before making that choice?

Wrong EPFO exit date? Here's how to correct it online step by stepThe date of exit is not just another entry in your EPFO service history. It forms part of your employment record and can affect several PF-related processes.

Forget Mumbai, Bengaluru. Surat is becoming India's new spending hubWith a population nearly the size of a Big Six city (Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad and Kolkata) and a large concentration of young people, Surat has emerged as India's largest consumption market outside the six megacities.

Sensex, Nifty fall as crude nears $98; IT stocks, West Asia tensions drag marketsAt 9:29 am, the BSE Sensex was down 401.85 points, or 0.53%, at 75,730.96. The index opened at 75,970.28 against Monday's close of 76,132.81. The Nifty 50 was down 108.15 points, or 0.45%, at 23,671.

Memory chip costs force Samsung India to cut jobs, 100 execs asked to leaveSamsung India has asked 80-100 executives in its television and home appliance businesses to leave in batches. The move reflects mounting cost pressures, weak demand and a wider restructuring across its India operations.

GDP numbers good, but not good enough for Viksit Bharat 2047, say top economistsIndia posted a better-than-expected 7.8% GDP growth in the first quarter of financial year 2026-27. However, economists Surjit Bhalla and Montek Singh Ahluwalia say India's dream of being a developed nation by 2047 will require much more than just a few quarters of strong growth.

LPG refill booking gap cut to 25 days from 45: What consumers need to knowThe new 25-day booking gap will apply uniformly to domestic LPG consumers in both urban and rural areas, with immediate effect.
HDFC Bank cuts loan rates by up to 10 bps: What it means for your loan EMIFollowing the latest revision, HDFC Bank's MCLR rates range from 7.90% to 8.60%, compared with 8% to 8.65% earlier.

Sebi changes ETF trading rules from today: What investors need to knowThe changes are aimed at making ETF prices respond more closely to the value of the assets they track, particularly during sharp market movements.

Homes are up 59%, construction costs 34%: What's really driving prices?The cost of building a home has risen sharply. Yet property prices have raced ahead, raising a bigger question: what is driving the gap? Let's have a look.

Sensex, Nifty end lower as IT stocks drag, West Asia tensions and crude oil weighThe BSE Sensex ended 382.62 points, or 0.50%, lower at 76,132.81, while the Nifty 50 declined 118.55 points, or 0.50%, to end at 23,779.15.

Sensex drops 500 points: Why is stock market down today?The biggest drag, however, has come from IT stocks, as fresh worries over US interest rates have added to the pressure from elevated crude oil prices and rising tensions in the Middle East.

entertainment.headline: Bigg Boss 20 Episode 3: Four nominated; Isha silent on relationship with Badshah In Episode 3 of Bigg Boss 20, the first nominations of the season left four contestants in the danger zone, while Aamrapali Dubey and Arishfa Khan engaged in a heated argument over age.

Preity Zinta addresses Batwara 1947 failure; says she remains proud of film Actor Preity Zinta has addressed Batwara 1947's box office failure. The film was directed by Rajkumar Santoshi and also featured actors Sunny Deol, Shabana Azmi, Ali Fazal and Karan Deol in key roles.

Aditya Seal sheds happy tears in twins' birth video with Anushka Ranjan. Watch Actor-couple Aditya Seal and Anushka Ranjan have shared unseen hospital footage from the birth of their twin daughters, Vira and Mahi. The emotional clip offers an intimate look at the couple embracing parenthood.

Akshay, Saif's thriller Haiwaan gets U/A 16+ from censor board; runtime revealed Haiwaan, featuring actors Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan has been cleared by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). The upcoming film is directed by Priyadarshan.

Inside Deepika-Ranveer's family album: Baby bump, Dua's smile and 'bigger hearts' Actors Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh shared pictures with baby Dua as she turned two-years-old. The actor couple had earlier confirmed their second pregnancy in April 2026.

Pralay first look: Truth behind Ranveer-Kalyani zombie film's viral poster The teaser poster of Pralay has been unveiled. The upcoming zombie thriller directed by Jai Mehta is set against the backdrop of a post-apocalyptic world.

Director Tigmanshu Dhulia not impressed with Dhurandhar 2, asks 'is there a story?' Paan Singh Tomar director Tigmanshu Dhulia has questioned Dhurandhar's storytelling despite praising its entertainment value. His remarks have sharpened the debate over formula, scale and originality in Hindi cinema.

Orry backs Gaurav Khanna amid Akanksha and Shagun controversies Orry said he publicly defended Khatron Ke Khiladi 15 co-contestant Gaurav Khanna during the row involving Akanksha Chamola and later backed him again over Shagun Sharma's bullying charge. He said Gaurav was too polished to respond himself and insisted the stunt-show confrontation was misread.

Bridgerton's Daphne, Phoebe Dynevor marries producer Cameron Fuller in France Actor Phoebe Dynevor reportedly married Cameron Fuller in a private ceremony in Provence on September 5. The low-key wedding reflected the couple's long preference for keeping their relationship out of the spotlight.

Kangana Ranaut slams character attacks on women, cites 'cheer haran' in Tamil Nadu Actor-turned-politician Kangana Ranaut has urged an end to the "character assassination" of women, citing alleged 'cheer haran' and recent attacks on a Tamil actor. Her remarks echo Tamil Nadu CM C Joseph Vijay's condemnation of personal attacks on women.

Ravi Kishan said 'Money follows my brother' and it did. The viral meme is now a song After dominating social media reels and online commentary for weeks, actor-politician Ravi Kishan's viral line is officially being turned into a song, with the newly unveiled promo sending fans into a frenzy.

Sanjay Dutt speaks fluent Marathi in old video after saying no to language on stage A video showing Sanjay Dutt speaking Marathi has resurfaced days after he sidestepped a similar request at a Mumbai event. The clip has triggered fresh debate online over his earlier joke and the wider language row in Maharashtra.

History of National Film Awards: The 72-year journey from Delhi to Gujarat The National Film Awards began in 1954 as the State Awards to honour Indian cinema. Over the decades, they expanded across languages, crafts and categories to become a leading national honour.

The Early Spring phenomenon: Why this Chinese drama refuses to leave India's Top 5 The Early Spring follows Luan Nian and Shang Zhitao through a six-year workplace romance on Netflix. Its easy availability in India and the debate around its flawed leads are keeping viewers talking.

Actor Anaswara Rajan is Ammulu Paapa in Chiranjeevi's Kaaka, first look out Actor Anaswara Rajan has been introduced as Ammulu Paapa, with the makers unveiling her look from director Bobby Kolli's Chiranjeevi-starrer on her birthday. The film is currently in production and is scheduled for a worldwide release on January 13, 2027.

Sonu Sood reacts to Delhi's Satya Niketan tragedy, calls for safe student hostels Actor Sonu Sood has called for safe and affordable student hostels in Delhi after the Satya Niketan PG building collapse.

National Film Awards to get a new venue every year, government releases statement The Information and Broadcasting Ministry has said the National Film Awards will now be held in different parts of the country, with the 72nd edition set for Gujarat on 22 September. The move breaks a decades-long practice of presenting the honours in Delhi and signals a wider national rollout for the ceremony.

Asha Bhosle's final film song Ae Meri Zindagi out on birth anniversary. Video Asha Bhosle's final feature-film song, Ae Meri Zindagi, has been released on her 93rd birth anniversary. Recorded in 2023, the song features in Harish Vyas' Om Ka Hari, which releases on September 18.

Chongtham Vikram Singh's story: The Manipuri musician beaten to delhi in Delhi Manipuri guitarist and teacher Chongtham Vikram Singh died after an alleged assault outside his Delhi home. His death has triggered outrage in the Northeast community and demands for a swift investigation.

general news.headline: US strikes Iranian tankers, IRGC vows to target oil vessels in Kuwait and BahrainUS military attacked have struck Iranian oil tankers following further attempted missile attacks on a US Navy warship. In response, Revolutionary Guards said that oil vessels in Kuwaiti and Bahraini ports hosting American forces will be targeted in retaliation.

Travel chaos at UK airports as air traffic control glitch cancels over 1,000 flightsNational Air Traffic Services initially said the problem had been traced to its flight processing system and that engineers were working to restore normal operations.

Got offer letter, ID card: Lawyer of fake PMO official Rohan Parekh tells courtMumbai Police said three men used a suspicious government ID and forced their way past security into Jio World Plaza. An FIR has been registered at BKC police station under various provisions of the BNS, including those relating to impersonation of a public servant and unlawful entry while armed with a weapon.

Kanpur engineer released days after detention in Russia, returns homeUP engineer Chandan Gupta, detained in Russia, has been released and is safely back home, according to his wife Sneha Gupta. Earlier, she had expressed concern that her husband could be pressured into joining the Russian military.

Maldives gave big-ticket project to China, paid just lip service to India?Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu might have moved closer to India, but the Chinese port made earlier this year is back in focus, showing that the island nation is not cutting ties with Beijing. As Male looks to fix its infrastructure and economic challenges, it appears to be keeping both India and China close, and benefiting from both.

US moves to choke Iran's aviation lifelines with new sanctions on 27 airlinesThe United States has imposed sweeping sanctions on 27 Iranian airlines and the foreign networks supporting them. As part of Donald Trump's 'Economic D-Day' campaign against Tehran, the US is widening its assault beyond Iran's airlines to target the overseas networks that help keep the country's aviation sector functioning.

Former Delhi chief secretary Rakesh Mehta dies by suicide, note found: OfficialsThe door of Mehta's flat was locked from inside, following which the police broke it open to enter the premises. His body was subsequently recovered from inside the residence.

Will DMK come? EPS challenges Stalin's party to forge alliance against VijayAIADMK general secretary Edappadi K Palaniswami challenged the DMK to join his party in an alliance against Vijay's TVK. His remarks came amid tensions in the Tamil Nadu Assembly, where he accused the Vijay government of failing to address corruption, inflation, law and order, drug abuse and farmers' concerns.

One last monsoon surge coming: Rains to return from this dateIndia may see one final burst of monsoon rain across several regions between September 12 and 21. The spell could briefly aid crops before the southwest monsoon retreat gathers pace.

Generate revenue, don't beg from Centre: Kangana Ranaut raps Himachal officialsBJP MP Kangana Ranaut slammed Himachal Pradesh officials for relying on large funds from the Centre instead of generating revenue, urging them to advance the One District One Product initiative. US halts Cognizant's green-card filings amid Trump's visa fraud crackdownThe US Labour Department has suspended Cognizant's PERM filings after a fraud investigation. The move deepens the Trump administration's scrutiny of employment visa programmes and employer compliance.

Venky's principal stayed with themSri Venkateswara College opened its campus, hostels and classrooms to students affected by the Satya Niketan building collapse. Around 70 students sought shelter, reflecting the fear among those living nearby. Venky principal, Professor Vajala Ravi, led the response asking students to stay on campus and assuring them of basic support.

Abdullahs stand for full Vande Mataram weeks after INDIA ally Congress objectsWhile Congress has stuck to its 1937 resolution limiting Vande Mataram to two stanzas, its INDIA bloc ally, NC leaders Omar Abdullah and Farooq Abdullah stood through all six stanzas at a Srinagar film festival. Their contrasting positions drew attention amid the ongoing political row over the national song.

Earthmovers pull down Ujjain temple, fail to move Khade Hanuman idolWhat happens when a road-widening project meets an idol that refuses to move? In Ujjain, workers have pulled down a temple structure, but repeated attempts to shift the Khade Hanuman idol have reportedly failed. Now, devotees see a divine sign, while officials are turning to experts.

Unstoppable Hanuman Ansh now beats Dhurandhar 2 in 5th weekend at box officeHanuman Ansh, a Rs 2-crore devotional drama, has pulled off a stunning box-office feat by surpassing the fifth-weekend collections of Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar films. Driven by strong word of mouth, the film has set a new benchmark for fifth-weekend collections in Hindi cinema.

Israel closes UK consulate in Jerusalem over trade ban on illegal settlementsIsrael has also barred Britain from a Gaza mission and blocked UK officials from entering the country as bilateral ties plunged to a new low.

Illegal: Kremlin hits back at Trump over sanctions, accuses US of weaponising dollarAhead of the BRICS summit in New Delhi, Dmitry Peskov called new US sanctions threats against Russia's trade partners illegal and unacceptable. The vigilance cell has arrested the officer for alleged criminal misconduct and amassing undisclosed assets.

sports.headline: Pakistan Women cricketers go viral for wearing Virat Kohli-branded shoes Pakistan Women cricketers have gone viral after several players, including left-arm spinner Nashra Sandhu, were spotted wearing Virat Kohli's one8 shoes during the Women's Asia Cup.

Bangladesh set up India clash in Women's Asia Cup semis, Pakistan face Sri Lanka Bangladesh beat the UAE by 34 runs to seal a Women's Asia Cup semi-final clash with unbeaten India. Pakistan will face defending champions Sri Lanka in the other semi-final on Friday.

Sabalenka escapes Noskova scare to reach semis, keeps 3-peat dream alive Aryna Sabalenka survived a huge Linda Noskova scare, edging the Wimbledon champion 7-6(1), 3-6, 7-6(7) to reach the US Open semi-finals. The win keeps her three-peat dream alive and extends her remarkable run in New York.

Confident Indian athletes won't fear opponents at Asian Games: Sports Minister Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya urged India's 503-member Asian Games contingent to compete without fear and turn pressure into performance as the country looks to build on its record-breaking medal haul from Hangzhou 2023

After Fatima Sana, another Pakistan cricketer fined by ICC in Women's Asia Cup Gull Feroza has been fined 10 per cent of her match fee for showing dissent at an umpire's decision during Pakistan's Women's Asia Cup clash against Hong Kong. Transgender women in cricket: Can inclusion and competitive fairness coexist? The debate over transgender participation in women's cricket sits at the intersection of inclusion, competitive fairness and evolving science. The cases of Anaya Bangar and ex-Canada cricketer Danielle McGahey highlight the complexity of determining how testosterone, puberty and hormone therapy affect sporting advantage.

Lionel Messi, Lamine Yamal among 30 nominated for Ballon D'Or 2026 Kylian Mbappe, Lamine Yamal, Harry Kane and Lionel Messi headline the 2026 Ballon d'Or nominees. Yamal eyes a third Kopa Trophy, while a new Yashin Trophy winner is guaranteed. The ceremony moves to London on October 26.

Ranjit Bajaj moves court over delayed elections in Indian football's governing bodyRanjit Bajaj has approached the court seeking early AIFF elections, challenging the delay in the electoral process. Mumbai Indians star goes berserk in Punjab T20 League, smashes 173 off 64 ballsNaman Dhir unleashed a stunning assault in the Punjab T20 League, smashing 173 off 64 balls to power Amritsar Soormas to victory over Mohali Kings. IPL franchises set to enter Big Bash League? Stunned Iga Swiatek loses cool at press after tough loss to Qinwen ZhengIga Swiatek's US Open campaign ended in stunning fashion as Qinwen Zheng fought back from 0-5 down to knock out the six-time Grand Slam champion. Ex-F1 boss Bernie Ecclestone detained at Portugal airport with shotgunBernie Ecclestone was detained at a Portuguese airport after officers found a shotgun without the required paperwork. He was released after surrendering the weapon, reviving attention on an earlier firearm incident in Brazil.

Gill goes 6, 4, 6 against Abhishek, but India star gets his revengeShubman Gill and Abhishek Sharma went head to head as Fazilka Falcons met Amritsar Soormas in Mohali. Gill made 67 and struck Abhishek for 6, 4, 6, but Sharma's 49 helped keep Soormas' semi-final hopes alive.

Washington Sundar fit for Afghanistan T20Is, Bumrah fitness report due Sep 9Washington Sundar has been cleared to play in India's three-match T20I series against Afghanistan. But the team is still waiting for fitness updates for Jasprit Bumrah, Harshit Rana and Nitish Kumar Reddy.

South Zone face a daunting task heading into Day 4, with Tilak Varma holding firm amid a challenging batting effort. With wickets falling around him and a huge first-innings deficit still to overcome, the pressure remains firmly on South Zone.
